quotes.text: I am so proud to have data centers in my rural community just south of Dallas. There was a lot of concern at the very beginning about what does this mean, this new technology, this new horizon of ours in technology and AI and everything that goes with it. I understand the fear of some of my colleagues on particularly the Eastern Seaboard, which is stretched thin with energy, power, and water and lines and so many other things. [...] This new technology gives them an opportunity to do so. They are doing so responsibly, with the cooperation of State and local governments.

as the demand for AI accelerates, America's digital infrastructure is rapidly expanding into rural communities. [...] Our rural communities and small businesses are at the center of America's AI-driven growth. [...] keep us competitive with the AI race with China.
